claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 77 attendees for this Hackathon, in line with turnout at our previous Hackathon events.
We can deliver this Hackathon efficiently within INR 15,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
